title: Husband and Wife
definition: Husband and wife describes the covenant relationship of mutual faithfulness, love, service, respect, and spiritual responsibility within marriage.
summary: Husbands and wives are called to love, serve, honor, and remain faithful to one another before God.
christFocus: Christ's sacrificial love for the Church provides the pattern for covenant faithfulness, humility, and self-giving love in marriage.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The relationship between husband and wife is meant to be shaped by covenant love and reverence for Christ. Scripture calls husbands and wives to faithfulness, mutual care, humility, truth, and service.

A husband is not called to selfish rule but to Christlike, sacrificial love. A wife is not called to lesser dignity but to faithful partnership and honor before the Lord. Both stand equally before God as image-bearers and heirs of grace.

Because marriage joins two sinners, the relationship requires ongoing repentance, forgiveness, patience, communication, and dependence on God's grace. A healthy marriage is not perfect people avoiding struggle, but two people learning covenant faithfulness under Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many marriages are damaged by pride, selfishness, neglect, harshness, or cultural confusion. This doctrine matters because it calls both husband and wife back to God's design of love, honor, service, and faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Examine how you speak, listen, serve, forgive, and sacrifice in marriage. Seek to reflect Christ more than defend yourself. Pray for humility, tenderness, truth, and perseverance.
